result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse, the function returns `refreshTokenResponse` — the zod safeParse result object ({success, data}) — not `refreshTokenResponse.data`. In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` is then persisted directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, whereas the original code stored `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)`. So the stored credential key is now a {success, data} wrapper, corrupting stored Google credentials.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new code sets `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `data: { key }`. However, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error }`), not the validated `data` itself. Persisting this wrapper would corrupt the stored credential key shape compared to the previous `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)` behavior.
